_doc: Supplementary diagnostics for FigG_condlogit_diagnostics: pooled candidate (delta_phys, delta_topo) sample, per-model standard errors from numerical Hessian, and posterior-predictive simulated topology-breaking rates (10 000 draws).

phys_topo_correlation.interpretation: High |rho| indicates confounding: topology and physicochemistry are correlated across the candidate landscape. Low |rho| suggests they carry independent information.
